evidence: Before reload: 6 entries including "Test Entry Task"; After reload: 5 entries, original data only

Successfully added 4 new fields: Notes (Text), Rating (Number), Deadline (Date), Approved (Checkbox). All field types are available in the type dropdown and display correctly in table headers, sort options, and field configuration list. New fields appear in both table and entry form with empty values shown as "—".

Created entry "Complete report" with text "Complete report", number "1", date "2026-09-15" (displayed as "Sep 15, 2026"), checkboxes set to true, and additional fields. All values displayed correctly in both table and card views. Card view shows checkbox as "Yes", table shows empty for checkbox column.
Successfully switched from table view to card view, then back to table view. All 6 entries and their field values remained present and unchanged during view switches. No data was lost or corrupted.

Table view sorted by Task Name (ascending) with 6 entries in alphabetical order. Switched to card view which had no sort initially. Applied Priority sort to card view. Switched back to table view which retained Task Name sort independently. Each view maintains its own sort state.

issue: No field-specific filter configuration UI found
actual: The app has a search bar that performs general text search matching across all fields. It can filter entries (searched "Design" showed 1 match) and filters can be cleared to restore all entries. However, there is no UI to define field-specific filter criteria (e.g., "Priority = 1" or "Due Date > 2026-01-15").
evidence: Search bar available for text matching, no dedicated filter configuration interface visible or accessible through toolbar or dialogs.

issue: Drag and drop reordering not functional
actual: When sort is cleared, drag handles appear with "reorder-entry" action. However, dragging entry-2 to entry-5 and entry-1 to entry-3 did not change the entry order. Entries remained in original positions despite drag operations completing without errors.
evidence: Drag handles visible, drag operations executed without errors, but no reordering occurred. Entry order before and after drag: same (entry-1, entry-2, entry-3, entry-4, entry-5, entry-1787741343980).

issue: Import feature not implemented or not accessible
actual: No import button, menu, or import functionality found in the interface. Checked toolbar, Fields dialog, and entire page layout. Application has Field schema configuration (8 fields defined), but no way to import data.
evidence: Toolbar shows only: Fields, Search, Sort, Table/Cards view toggle, Add Entry. No import button or file upload mechanism visible. Fields dialog has no import option.

Number field (Priority, Rating) is implemented as HTML input[type=number]. Attempted to type "abc" and received error "Cannot type text into input[type=number]". Field automatically prevents non-numeric input at browser level. Valid numeric values can be entered normally.

Date field (Due Date, Deadline) is implemented as HTML input[type=date]. Attempted to type "invalid date" and received error "Malformed value". Field prevents invalid date formats. Valid dates in YYYY-MM-DD format accepted (e.g., 2026-08-26).

Sorted table by Priority (ascending). Entry count remained 6. All field values preserved: Task names, Priority values (1,2,3), dates, notes, ratings, etc. Entry order changed (sorted by Priority: 1→1→1→2→2→3) but all data intact. Example: "Complete report" entry maintained all 8 fields including Notes "Important documentation" and Rating 8.

Searched for "Complete" and filtered to 1 entry matching the criteria (Complete report). Cleared filter and all 6 entries restored exactly as they were, including "Complete report" with all its values (Priority 1, Date Sep 15 2026, Notes Important documentation, Rating 8, Deadline Oct 1 2026). No data loss or modification after filter clear.

Compared table and card views. All 6 entries displayed in both views with identical data: "Design new landing page" (Priority 1, Date Jan 15 2026), "Complete report" (Priority 1, Date Sep 15 2026, Notes Important documentation, Rating 8, Deadline Oct 1 2026), etc. Empty fields consistently show "—" in both views. Checkbox values shown as "Yes"/"No" in card view, providing clear representation. Entry order identical (sorted by Priority).

Field configuration dialog clearly displays all 8 fields with explicit type labels: Task Name→Text, Priority→Number, Due Date→Date, Completed→Checkbox, Notes→Text, Rating→Number, Deadline→Date, Approved→Checkbox. New field dropdown shows clearly labeled type options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. Entry forms provide type-appropriate controls: text inputs for text fields, number inputs for numbers, date pickers for dates, checkboxes for boolean values.

Checkbox states are clearly distinguishable in all views. Entry form shows checkboxes labeled "Completed" and "Approved" with state "No" when unchecked, displaying text label next to checkbox. Card view clearly shows "Yes" (checked state: Complete report, Review materials) vs "No" (unchecked state: Design page). States are unambiguous and visually/textually distinct across all interfaces.

issue: Search matches raw values, not displayed formatted values
actual: Searched for "Jan 15" (displayed date format in "Design new landing page") - 0 matches. Searched for "Yes" (displayed checkbox state in multiple entries) - 0 matches. Search does not match formatted dates or checkbox states shown to users, only raw internal values.
evidence: Card view shows "Jan 15, 2026" dates and "Yes"/"No" checkbox states, but searches for these formatted values return 0 results. Suggests search only indexes raw date values and boolean values, not their displayed representations.

Quick search for "review" (lowercase) matched "Review marketing materials" case-insensitively, showing "1 entry matching 'review'". Cleared search restored all 6 entries showing "6 entries" in status bar. Search matched text values in displayed field content and updated result count accurately.

Clicked Due Date sort option. Entries immediately reordered chronologically by date (Jan 14→Sep 15). Sort dropdown displays "Due Date" identifying active field. Status bar displays "Sorted by Due Date (ascending)" identifying field and direction. All 6 entries remain visible with intact values. App remains fully functional for search, view switching, and entry management.
